**Technical Controls Assessment \& Validation** 



* Conduct routine technical assessments to verify that credential auto\-rotation, check\-in/check\-out policies, and password complexity controls function across all onboarded targets.
* Validate that Privileged Session Monitoring (PSM) and keylogging controls capture and index administrative sessions without bypassing.
* Audit Entra PIM policies: verify mandatory MFA triggers, justification requirements, approval chains, and maximum activation duration limits.
* Perform discovery scans to identify unmanaged privileged accounts, service accounts, and shadow admins across Active Directory, cloud, and hybrid environments.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

 Hands\-on experience with at least one enterprise PAM tool (CyberArk PAS/Privilege Cloud, BeyondTrust Password Safe, Delinea/Thycotic) and Cloud PIM (Microsoft Entra ID PIM).

* **Scripting:** 
 Basic PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripting skills to assist with automated onboarding, discovery parsing, and API calls.
* **Security Principles:** 
 Solid understanding of Least Privilege, Zero Trust, MFA, Session Isolation, and Break\-Glass procedures.

* CyberArk Defender (PAM\-DEF) or Sentry (PAM\-SEN)

title: Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations (Individual Contributor)
description:
**About the company** 




 TRYST is a research\-to\-translation institution on the IIT Bombay campus, working across semiconductors, AI, health and bio, energy and clean technology, and related verticals. It is building the digital and IT environment for a multi\-Centre organisation that is expected to scale toward 1,000\+ people, while remaining on campus and partnering with IIT Bombay shared services.
 



 This is a founding IT role: the opportunity to design and run the function, not to inherit one.
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 Own TRYST’s IT infrastructure and day\-to\-day IT operations — identity and endpoint operations on Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, TRYST cloud and overlay connectivity, devices, backups, and first\-line service.
 



 Build the function from a standing start: standards, vendors, assets and the first hires. Do the work yourself until there is a team. Coordinate campus network, licensed software and journal access with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre rather than recreating those services. Grow the role into Head of Infrastructure as TRYST scales.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Note : It's an Individual Contributor role initially and based on Org. requirements , the team can be aligned later.
 



**Infrastructure, cloud and campus overlay** 



* Design, implement and operate TRYST\-owned infrastructure: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, the endpoint estate, file and backup services, TRYST cloud (Azure as the starting tenancy), and overlay connectivity on the campus network.
* Partner with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre on campus LAN/Wi\-Fi, research computing, and software / journal catalogues. Own the TRYST overlay, the join path for a new employee, and the escalation path to Computing Centre.
* Set infrastructure standards and runbooks that will still hold as TRYST grows across Centres and toward 1,000\+ people, on a common identity and device baseline.
* Plan capacity, backup and disaster recovery for TRYST\-owned systems. Campus backbone DR remains with Computing Centre.



**Identity, endpoint and security operations** 



* Operate Microsoft 365 / Entra ID as TRYST’s directory: account hygiene, groups, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and the joiner / mover / leaver path from the HR system (Keka).
* Own endpoint management and protection (Intune or equivalent, disk encryption, patching and baseline hardening). TRYST handles research IP; unmanaged devices are not the default.
* Own infrastructure security for TRYST\-run systems: access, backups, incident first\-response, and the first set of IT security policies with the CEO.
* Keep security usable. Default access should follow the employee’s role; exceptions should be the minority.



**Service delivery** 



* Provide IT support until a dedicated service desk exists: provisioning, workstation and access issues, with a published response target.
* Establish a single, simple request channel and evolve it as headcount grows.
* Support lab, compute and connectivity needs of research Centres, escalating specialised research computing to Computing Centre or an agreed cloud pattern.



**Vendors, assets and budget** 



* Own vendor relationships for devices, connectivity overlays, cloud, endpoint security and any managed\-service overflow.
* Maintain the IT asset register and lifecycle — issue, recover, wipe and recycle — tied to joining and leaving.
* Manage the infrastructure and endpoint budget and provide actuals for TRYST IT cost planning.



**Team and operating model** 



* Hire, coach and oversee the first support and infrastructure engineers as workload justifies it.
* Clarify ownership between TRYST IT, HR, Finance and Computing Centre, including where a service is TRYST\-owned, outsourced, or provided by IIT Bombay.
* Leave the organisation able to add a Head of IT, an applications lead and a security lead as TRYST scales, without rewiring this job.



**EXPERIENCE** 




**Required** 




 8–12 years in IT infrastructure, systems, network or workplace/endpoint engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership rather than ticket\-only support.
 



 • Hands\-on with cloud identity and modern workplace (Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or a close equivalent): directory, MFA and device management — not only on\-premises Active Directory.
 



 • Experience designing and operating network, server/cloud and backup/disaster\-recovery environments.
 



 • Vendor, contract and budget management. Experience hiring or coaching at least one engineer.
 



 • Comfortable remaining hands\-on — imaging a laptop, resolving connectivity issues, supporting a joiner — as well as designing the environment.
 



**Preferred** 




 Built infrastructure for a growing organisation rather than only running a mature one.
 



 • Campus, academic, research\-lab or institutional environments, especially coordinating with a central computing or network group you do not control.
 



 • Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver) with an HR system such as Keka.
 



 • Familiarity with Indian vendor and procurement practice, and with Mumbai / IIT campus context.
 



  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 



* High tolerance for ambiguity: standards will be written here, not inherited.
* Judgement that balances security, reliability and pace — research IP on one side, an early\-stage timetable on the other.
* Credibility with scientists, operators and vendors, and the ability to hold a single TRYST IT stack rather than parallel Centre\-level ones.
* A bias to hands\-on execution in the first year, with the systems thinking so the second year is not a rewrite.



  





**REMUNERATION** 




**Level** 




 Manager.
 



**Compensation** 




 Competitive and commensurate with experience

title: Configuration Manager
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Configuration Manager
 
  
 



**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
 



  
 



 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa\-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high\-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
 


  About the Role
 
 Agfa is seeking a
 **Configuration Manager** 
 to join its Global ICS (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and governance of configuration and asset information across Agfa's global IT environment. You will own the Configuration Management process and ensure that the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) accurately reflects the current state of IT services, infrastructure, applications, and assets throughout their lifecycle.
 



 As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will support critical IT processes including Change Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Asset Management, and Risk Management. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, business units, service providers, and technology partners to ensure reliable data, effective governance, and operational excellence.
 


  About You (Skills Required)
 
 You are highly organized, detail\-oriented, and passionate about data quality and governance. You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders, improving processes, and creating transparency across complex IT environments.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong coordination and organizational skills.
* A structured and process\-driven mindset.
* Strong understanding of data quality, governance, and compliance principles.
* A proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.


  What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)
 * Own and continuously improve the Configuration Management process.
* Ensure Configuration Item (CI) records remain accurate, complete, and up to date throughout their lifecycle.
* Manage, maintain, and enhance the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), including data structures, standards, and governance controls.
* Support Change Management by ensuring configuration data is available, accurate, and aligned with approved changes.
* Conduct configuration audits and verification activities to ensure compliance and data accuracy.
* Monitor and improve data integrity and quality across configuration and asset records.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, business units, vendors, and service providers to maintain accurate configuration information.
* Validate and reconcile managed Configuration Items with Agfa business units.
* Ensure timely tracking and return of leased devices to leasing companies.
* Produce governance reports, metrics, and compliance reporting related to configuration and asset management.
* Manage configuration\-related escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Act as backup for the Change Manager when required.


  What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)
 * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* Proven experience in Configuration Management, Asset Management, IT Service Management, or IT Operations.
* Strong understanding of Configuration Management principles, CMDB governance, and IT asset lifecycle management.
* Experience working with CMDB platforms and asset management solutions.
* Solid understanding of IT Service Management processes, including Change, Incident, and Problem Management.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and collaborating with external service providers.
* Strong reporting, data governance, and process management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
* ITIL Foundation certification or comparable IT Service Management certification is considered an asset.


  Why Join Us
 * Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that underpins business\-critical operations worldwide.
* Collaborate with international teams, service providers, and technology partners.
* Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, and operational stability across Agfa's global IT landscape.
* Help build a reliable and transparent IT environment that enables effective service delivery and informed decision\-making.



  
 



 If you are passionate about Configuration Management, governance, data integrity, and continuous improvement, and you enjoy working in a global IT environment, we invite you to join Agfa and contribute to the reliability and effectiveness of our worldwide IT services.

description:
**Security Operations Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to build AI systems that reason through real\-world security incidents — and we need experienced SOC analysts to make it happen.
   

  

 Your expertise in threat detection, alert triage, and incident response will directly shape how next\-generation AI understands and navigates modern security operations. This is a rare opportunity to influence frontier AI from the inside, without leaving your area of expertise.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze realistic SOC scenarios — incidents, alerts, and investigation workflows — to evaluate how AI systems reason through them
* Classify alert severity, determine root causes, and recommend appropriate response actions
* Review AI\-generated detection logic and investigation outputs for accuracy and real\-world alignment
* Validate that AI responses reflect how skilled analysts actually detect, triage, and respond to threats
* Provide structured feedback that directly improves AI model performance in security contexts
* Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in SOC, incident response, or security operations roles
* Solid familiarity with SIEM platforms, alert triage processes, and investigation workflows
* Sharp instinct for separating true security signals from noise and false positives
* Able to articulate your reasoning clearly in written form
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently on task\-based assignments


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with threat hunting, malware analysis, or digital forensics
* Familiarity with frameworks like MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST, or the Cyber Kill Chain
* Background working across multiple SIEM or SOAR platforms
* Interest in AI systems and how they're trained and evaluated


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on cutting\-edge AI projects with top\-tier research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Make a meaningful impact on how AI handles real\-world cybersecurity challenges
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Information Security Manager
description:
**Location : Mumbai** 




**Designation :** 
 Information Security Manager
 



  





**About the role** 




 We're looking for someone to build BitDelta's information security function from the ground up — and stay hands\-on while doing it.
 



  





 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a team and a playbook. You'll create both. You'll design the security architecture that protects our live trading platform, run our penetration testing and red\-team work, keep us compliant with the regulators who matter, oversee our SOC and incident response, and act as our Data Protection Officer.
 



  





 It's a builder's job, and a technical one. We care most about strong security fundamentals. If you know crypto and blockchain, great — but you don't need to be an expert on day one. A solid high\-level understanding is enough, and we'll teach you the rest. What we can't teach is a security\-first instinct.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




**Security architecture and operations** 




 You'll own the whole security picture — the exchange app, the APIs, and everything underneath. That means driving application security and secure development practices, staying on top of vulnerabilities as they surface, and hardening endpoints across our Mumbai offices. You'll run our 24x7 SOC monitoring, write the runbooks and escalation paths, and lead incidents from the first alert through to the post\-mortem.
 



  





**Offensive security** 




 You'll plan and run penetration tests across the application, network, and infrastructure — including the live platform. You'll work with both internal and external red teams, think like an attacker to find gaps before anyone else does, and design phishing simulations and social engineering tests to keep everyone sharp. Then you'll chase every finding through to a fix.
 



  





**Governance, risk, and compliance** 




 You'll own our security governance — the policies, standards, and controls, aligned to ISO 27001, NIST, and general good practice. You'll handle regulatory queries from FIU\-IND, CERT\-In, and others, make sure our controls stay audit\-ready, and support internal and external audits and risk assessments.
 



  





**Data protection** 




 As our DPO under India's DPDP Act 2023, you'll represent BitDelta on data\-protection matters with regulators. You'll get to know our data deeply — how it moves, where it lives, who can touch it — and own classification, lifecycle management, privacy controls, DPIAs, and breach notifications.

The Senior Associate will manage and strengthen the organization’s information\-security posture, Google Workspace environment, endpoints, and core IT infrastructure. The role will lead the migration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace and support secure, reliable day\-to\-day technology operations, compliance activities, incident response, and infrastructure improvements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace Migration** 




 • Plan and execute the migration of email, calendars, contacts, files, shared drives, user accounts, groups, permissions, and related services from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace.
 



 • Prepare migration plans, user mapping, data validation, rollback and cutover procedures while ensuring data integrity, security, compliance, and minimal business disruption.
 



 • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and implementation partners; provide post\-migration support, issue resolution, user guidance, and controlled decommissioning of redundant Microsoft services.
 



  





**2\. Google Workspace Administration \& Security** 




 • Administer users, organizational units, groups, domains, shared drives, licences, administrative roles, Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet, Groups, and Google Vault.
 



 • Configure MFA, SSO, access controls, external\-sharing restrictions, retention policies, email protection, security alerts, investigation rules, audit logging, eDiscovery, and legal holds.
 



 • Perform periodic reviews of privileged access, inactive accounts, external sharing, security settings, and service health; resolve escalated administration, access, and email\-delivery issues.
 



  





**3\.** 
**Endpoint Management \& Endpoint Security** 




 • Manage the lifecycle of Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS devices, including enrolment, configuration, patching, application deployment, inventory, compliance monitoring, and secure decommissioning.
 



 • Operate MDM/UEM, EDR, antivirus, anti\-malware, firewall, disk\-encryption, device\-control, and endpoint\-compliance solutions; define secure configuration baselines for corporate and BYOD devices.
 



 • Monitor endpoint alerts, investigate compromised or non\-compliant devices, and enforce controls for removable media, local administration, browser security, application installation, and data transfer.
 



 • Maintain endpoint and asset records and establish secure device processes for employee onboarding, role changes, offboarding, data removal, and warranty or lifecycle management.
 



  





**4\. Security Operations, DLP \& Incident Response** 




 •Conduct security\-posture assessments, review policies and configurations, track identified risks and remediation actions and implement practical enhancements with internal teams and security partners.
 



 •Implement and manage DLP controls across email, web, cloud applications, and endpoints; investigate alerts and refine rules to protect sensitive information while minimizing false positives. •Manage escalated security incidents, including phishing, compromised accounts, malware, endpoint isolation, and suspected data leakage; document root cause, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
 



  





**5\. VAPT, ISO 27001 \& Compliance** 




 •Coordinate VAPT scope, access, schedules, rules of engagement, evidence, remediation, retesting, and closure with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
 



 •Maintain vulnerability registers and support ongoing remediation across endpoints, networks, servers, cloud platforms, and applications.
 



 •Support ISO 27001, internal, customer, and regulatory audits by coordinating evidence, control testing, risk assessments, non\-conformities, corrective actions, and compliance documentation.
 



  





**6\. IT Infrastructure, VDI \& Vendor Management** 




 •Support secure and reliable office networks, internet connectivity, servers, storage, backups, recovery readiness, and related infrastructure upgrades or office migrations.
 



 •Evaluate VDI and other secure\-access solutions for remote work and BYOD, covering identity, data protection, device isolation, performance, scalability, and user experience.
 



 •Coordinate service providers and technology vendors for evaluation, procurement, implementation, maintenance, escalations, and proofs of concept.
 



  





**7\. Operations, Documentation \& Collaboration** 




 •Resolve escalated IT infrastructure and information security issues and collaborate with business teams, management, auditors, and vendors on technical and security requirements.
 



 •Maintain policies, SOPs, infrastructure diagrams, inventories, configuration records, troubleshooting guides, handover documents, licences, and operational reports.
 



 •Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve security, scalability, reliability, operational efficiency, and user experience.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 




 •Over 4 Years \+ Hands\-on experience in information security, IT infrastructure, endpoint administration, or a comparable role
 



 •Strong Google Workspace administration and security expertise, including Admin Console, Gmail, Drive, Shared Drives, Vault, endpoint management, access controls, and audit capabilities.
 



 •Experience with Microsoft 365\-to\-Google Workspace migrations and working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Microsoft security controls.
 



 •Practical knowledge of MDM/UEM, EDR, patching, device compliance, IAM, MFA, SSO, RBAC, DLP, incident response, VAPT, vulnerability management, and ISO 27001\.
 



 •Working understanding of networks, firewalls, VPNs, servers, storage, backups, cloud services, and business\-continuity requirements.
 



 •Strong troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder\-management, vendor\-coordination, and project\-execution skills.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 •Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
 



 •Google Workspace Administrator, Google Cloud, ISO 27001, Security\+, CEH, CISM, CISSP, or similar certification is advantageous but not mandatory.
 



  





**Key Competencies Ownership and accountability** 




 •Security\-first thinking
 



 •Structured problem\-solving
 



 •Clear communication
 



 •Cross\-functional collaboration
 



 •Attention to detail
 



 •Ability to manage multiple priorities and escalations

 , a leading global infrastructure investor with a focus on digital infrastructure, energy, utilities, and transportation.
 



 Learn more: www.bdxworld.com
 



  





 Please note this is a strictly technical role requiring hands\-on firewall experience and relevant skills as per the JD. Candidates without this experience are requested not to apply.

 The Associate Director IT Security Lead will provide security incident response and readiness as part of a 24x7 Security Operations Centre within and in support of the IT and OT Security Infrastructure for the organization. Support global vulnerability management processes including OS and infrastructure patching, hardening and testing efforts. Operatesecurity related tools (HIDS, NIDS, IPS, Analysers, Scanners, etc.) to identify activethreats, attacks, vulnerabilities, exposures, etc., and prioritize for activity within the team. title: Security Design and Integration Manager - India
description:
­Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast\-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.
   

  

 Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.
   

  

 The
 ****Security Design and Integration Manager****
 will drive efforts in securing data centers across India and will be based out of Mumbai, or Hyderabad, working in a remote setup.
   

  

 This role supports the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects in the region, from early design through commissioning and turnover, and oversees compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards across security design, integration, implementation, and programming. The role also supports the integration of EdgeConneX security and customer security efforts, ensuring compliance with all applicable standards. Successful execution requires strong navigation of local construction practices, regulatory authorities, and stakeholder dynamics, and the ability to build durable working relationships with sophisticated enterprise customers. This position is customer\-facing and must uphold the ideals of EdgeConneX excellence.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Support the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects across from early design through commissioning and site turnover and oversee compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards throughout.
* Serve as subject matter expert (SME) on EdgeConneX requirements and physical security standards, providing authoritative guidance to project teams, delivery partners, and stakeholders.
* Support the definition of project security requirements and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment to EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer expectations.
* Support procurement and provide technical oversight of security designers, integrators, and programmers.
* Review security designs and submittals produced by integration partners for compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercoms, and related field devices.
* Liaise with customer security teams and local construction teams to align AdaniConneX project delivery with EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer\-specific requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate and liaise with both AdaniConneX stakeholders and customer subject matter experts (SMEs) to align on security requirements, resolve issues, and maintain a shared understanding throughout delivery.
* Oversight of physical security systems, including S2, Lenel, and Genetec systems.
* Validate installation and configuration quality through quality checks, site walks, and commissioning reviews; audit security contractors on quality, schedule, and compliance.
* Support closure of design gaps, defects, and punch items, including verification of corrective actions.
* Adapt EdgeConneX baseline standards to local conditions and to authorities holding jurisdiction in India.
* Maintain documentation quality, including design drawings, as\-built records, test results, configuration records, and turnover packages.
* Provide estimating and budgeting inputs for physical security systems when requested.
* Collaborate with Security Operations on site turnover and operational acceptance.
* Participate in shaping Security Design and Integration global standards and processes, and improve standards, templates, and repeatable design patterns to reduce rework and improve consistency across the portfolio.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong technical understanding of physical security systems and integration methods.
* Ability to evaluate designs quickly, identify gaps, and make practical decisions under delivery pressure.
* Strong vendor management sets expectations, enforces baseline requirements, and holds delivery partners accountable.
* Strong communications, both written and verbal, in leading teams and coordinating with peers and other disciplines on driving projects and issues to closure.
* Clear communicator who can translate technical requirements into simple, executable direction for integration partners and internal project teams.
* Customer\-facing presence; able to represent EdgeConneX professionally with sophisticated enterprise customers and sustain alignment through extended ramp and onboarding cycles.
* Strong and effective team player working across various disciplines and peer groups; able to cover the full range of tasks required to get the job done.
* Superb ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.
* Disciplined execution: tracking, documentation, follow\-through, and closure.
* Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders in a multilingual Indian environment without losing attention to detail.
* Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness of opportunities to improve processes and quality of deliverables.
* Superb ability to work independently while adhering to standards.
* Ability to use computer systems related to security management and reporting.


**Experience / Education**
* 3\+ years of experience in physical security design, systems integration, or physical security program delivery.
* Minimum 2 of those years managing large\-scale security design and installation projects.
* Experience supporting critical infrastructure environments; Data center experience strongly preferred.
* Experience delivering in India or the broader APAC region, including working knowledge of local construction practices and jurisdictional security requirements.
* Experience working with technical drawings and standard construction deliverables such as submittals, requests for information, and as\-built documentation.

title: SLP Manager
description:
**Description**
 Senior Loss Prevention Manager position serves as the primary operational resource to support the loss prevention initiatives in the EDSP, Easy Ship and Seller flex programs. The mission of the India SLP team is to mitigate security and operational risks to the associates, data, physical assets \& inventory. The SLP team ensures smooth run of the day\-to\-day business operations by protecting against various threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks, thereby ensuring a safe and secure work environment. This is achieved by preventing the SLP related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible; by intervening in unfolding incidents and exposures to minimize any negative impact; and by investigating thoroughly security related incidents to identify and remove root causes and to prevent re\-occurrence. In addition, the job holder will support investigation activities concerning losses and other incidents within Amazon’s Last Mile Operations, conduct due diligence and audits to assess the Security of potential or existing business partners and vendors in the areas of transportation, storage, logistics and distribution of Amazon products; and define and implement regional Last Mile Security strategies for education and awareness across the organization.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Provide guidance and support for Security and Loss Prevention teams; supply chain, logistics and transportation operations and coordination groups, other stakeholders with the Amazon organization and third parties.
* Deploy and implement risk assessment methodologies specifically cut to address current and foreseeable risks within the last mile environments, scenarios and use cases; methods to identify and implement the security strategies for last mile itineraries within the region, in accordance with risks assessment; and conducting security due diligence assessments on potential business partners such as wholesalers, third party logistics, delivery service providers (DSP), and other business\-critical functions regionally
* Implement key liaison contacts in industry, law enforcement, government and regulatory agencies to maintain awareness of and provide tactical response to upcoming legislation, industry trends, external risks and new technologies related to last mile operations
* Ensure compliance to internal standards by means of supporting the Global Security Risk Compliance Audit team in defining the requirements for Last Mile (LM) Security; collaborate and provide expertise in conducting internal security audits; partner with appropriate stakeholders to implement effective audit programs to detect, prevent and resolve LM losses; implement and provide guidance for conducting audits to assess the Last Mile Security of business partners, vendors, third party logistics providers, and carriers in the areas of transportation, sortation, and delivery distribution; and follow up on definition and implementation of corrective action plans.
* Implement internal business stakeholder support in order to promote security as added value and business differentiator; provide direct input to the relevant internal stakeholders and operational teams on high risk new business initiatives within the last mile environment; partner with appropriate internal stakeholders to provide security input regarding the selection of third party last mile providers (DSP); implement key collaborations with regional stakeholders to implement consistent standards, programs, assessments and procedures for the network with careful consideration for implementing and maintaining relationships with affiliate management and international partners
